experiment.title: Typed five-term projective shared-sign source-state operator
experiment.objective: Measure whether a shared-Z Jacobian P+S/P-S source operator preserves exact zero-locator support while eliminating generic source inversions.

inputs.operator: shared-Z Jacobian P+S/P-S with homogeneous Z^12 norm predicate

stopping_rules: charge projective predicate multiplications and cache payload
do not treat homogeneous zero support as affine value equality
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidation_rules: invalidate on any projective reconstruction mismatch
do not treat sub-full failure as full solver failure
invalidate if clean verifier or rho certificates fail
experiment.success_criterion: Full controls, independent projective arithmetic, and homogeneous zero-equivalence pass; a stronger result requires a three-curve sub-full gate and weighted charged-cost advantage.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Any arithmetic or zero-equivalence mismatch, failed full support, rank loss, or no complete charged source-state improvement.
